  • Method Details

    • getMealTotals

      public void getMealTotals(String date, String userId, MealService.MealServiceCallback callback)
      Retrieves the total nutritional information for all meals on a specific date. Makes a GET request to /meals/totals/{date}/?username={userId}
      Parameters:
      date - The date for which to retrieve meal totals (format: yyyy-MM-dd)
      userId - The unique identifier of the user
      callback - Callback to handle the API response

    • getMealsByDate

      public void getMealsByDate(String date, String userId, MealService.MealServiceCallback callback)
      Retrieves all meals for a specific date and user. Makes a GET request to /meals/{date}/{userId}
      Parameters:
      date - The date for which to retrieve meals (format: yyyy-MM-dd)
      userId - The unique identifier of the user
      callback - Callback to handle the API response

    • addMeal

      public void addMeal(String date, String userId, org.json.JSONObject mealData, MealService.MealServiceCallback callback)
      Adds a new meal to the specified date for the user. Makes a POST request to /meals/food/{date}/{userId}
      Parameters:
      date - The date for which to add the meal (format: yyyy-MM-dd)
      userId - The unique identifier of the user
      mealData - JSONObject containing the meal information including: - foodName: name of the food - servingSize: size of the serving - calories: number of calories - protein: grams of protein - carbs: grams of carbohydrates - fat: grams of fat
      callback - Callback to handle the API response

    • updateMeal

      public void updateMeal(String date, String userId, String mealType, org.json.JSONObject mealData, MealService.MealServiceCallback callback)
      Updates an existing meal for the specified user. Makes a PUT request to /meals/2
      Parameters:
      date - The date of the meal to update (format: yyyy-MM-dd)
      userId - The unique identifier of the user
      mealType - The type of meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks)
      mealData - JSONObject containing the updated meal information
      callback - Callback to handle the API response

    • deleteMeal

      public void deleteMeal(String date, String userId, String mealType, MealService.MealServiceCallback callback)
      Deletes a meal for the specified user. Makes a DELETE request to /meals/meal/6
      Parameters:
      date - The date of the meal to delete (format: yyyy-MM-dd)
      userId - The unique identifier of the user
      mealType - The type of meal to delete (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks)
      callback - Callback to handle the API response
